entry_conditions.object: to do this simply go to metatrader click insert then indicators scroll down to oscillate and click momentum so here you can see the indicator gave us a long Buy Signal but something else to notice is that here the chart did a liquidity grab so it's making lower lows but if we look at the momentum oscillator it's making higher highs so this is a Divergence and is also a very bullish signal so we combine both the powers of the Divergence and the bullish liquidity grab and it gives us a higher probability of working in our favor
